en.headline: Thunderstorm warning extended until 5pm, Observatory says
en.dek: The warning issued at 1:03pm remains in force until 5pm, after lightning over the New Territories and isolated showers.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said in its 2:31pm weather report that the thunderstorm warning issued at 1:03pm on Sunday remained in force until 5pm. Isolated thunderstorms were expected over Hong Kong.

The Observatory advised people outdoors to seek shelter, to leave the water and not to swim or take part in other outdoor water sports, and to stay off high ground and away from conductive objects, trees and masts.

Between 12:45pm and 1:45pm, lightning was recorded over the eastern and western New Territories. Rainfall in that hour reached up to 13 millimetres in Sha Tin and up to 10 millimetres in North District, the Observatory said. Yau Tsim Mong recorded up to 8 millimetres, while several other districts had little or no rain.

At 2pm the Observatory recorded 29 degrees and relative humidity of 86 per cent. Among district readings, Shek Kong was at 33 degrees, and Lau Fau Shan, Tuen Mun, Stanley and Yuen Long Park were at 32 degrees. The weather cartoon was sunny intervals with showers.

zh.headline: 雷暴警告延長至下午5時 新界有閃電
zh.dek: 天文台下午2時31分的天氣報告指，下午1時03分發出的雷暴警告有效至下午5時，新界東西早前錄得閃電。
body: 香港天文台在下午2時31分的天氣報告表示，星期日下午1時03分發出的雷暴警告仍然生效，有效時間至下午5時，預料本港有局部地區雷暴。
天文台提醒，雷暴期間身處室外應到安全地方躲避，離開水面，切勿游泳或進行其他戶外水上運動，亦勿站立高地或接近導電物體、樹木或桅杆。
下午12時45分至1時45分，新界東及新界西有閃電紀錄。該小時雨量方面，沙田錄得0至13毫米，北區0至10毫米，油尖旺0至8毫米，其餘多區雨量較少或沒有錄得雨量。
下午2時，天文台錄得氣溫29度，相對濕度86%。各區氣溫方面，石崗33度，流浮山、屯門、赤柱及元朗公園32度。天氣插圖為短暫陽光，有驟雨。
